bookingOpens: Online on TheFork from the restaurant's website, or by phone. Covers are limited, so the restaurant advises booking several weeks ahead, and further ahead for weekends, summer and special dates.
cancellation: Changes and cancellations are possible if made as early as possible; the terms are given when the booking is confirmed.
groups: A dedicated team handles groups, private hire and events, through the restaurant's group booking page.
dressCode: Smart casual. At dinner, men are asked to wear long trousers and closed shoes.
